semantic_detail.source_summary: Kaynaklar ortak biçimde dalı evlenme ve eş edinme anlamıyla açıklar; ayrıca dua kalıbında kişiye eş verilmesi ve onun için yakın çevre yapılması anlamı korunur.

semantic_detail.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مطلق القرابة أو السكن إلا إذا تعلق بالتزوج أو جعل الأهل.

semantic_detail.source_phrase_ar: الأصل الآخر الإهالة وهي الألية ونحوها يؤخذ فيقطع ويذاب (maqayis)؛ الإهالة الودك والمستأهل الذي يأخذ الإهالة أو يأكلها (sihah)؛ الإهالة هي الشحم والزيت قط؛ كل ما اؤتدم به من زبد وودك شحم ودهن سمسم وغيره فهو إهالة؛ استأهل الرجل إذا ائتدم بالإهالة (tahdhib)

semantic_detail.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أهل الرجل أو أهل البيت أو أهلية الشيء للأمر؛ فهذا أصل آخر عند مقاييس.

semantic_detail.source_phrase_ar: الخوف ضد الأمن خاف يخاف خوفا (jamhara خفو)؛ والخيفة مثل الخوف والجمع خيف (jamhara خيف)؛ خاف الرجل يخاف خوفا وخيفة ومخافة فهو خائف؛ والخيفة الخوف والجمع خيف وأصله الواو (sihah)؛ الخوف توقع مكروه عن أمارة مظنونة أو معلومة ويضاد الخوف الأمن (mufradat)؛ أصل واحد يدل على الذعر والفزع؛ خفت الشيء خوفا وخيفة (maqayis 992)؛ الخيف فجمع خيفة وليس من هذا الباب وقد ذكر في باب الواو بعد الخاء (maqayis 1001)؛ الخيفة الخوف (ayn)
semantic_detail.source_summary: Tanıklıklar korku ve ürküntüyü ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Bazı anlatımlar bu hali güvenin karşıtı diye sınırlar, bazıları ise bilinen ya da sanılan bir belirtiden hareketle kötü bir sonuç bekleme yönünü açıklar. Kaynaklar, çoğul biçimin bu kök altında değerlendirilip değerlendirilmemesi konusunda ayrılır.

semantic_detail.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الغبار ولونه، ولا الماضي المحض إذا أريد الانقضاء لا البقاء.

semantic_detail.identity_rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek ve acik bicimde gerinme anlamini verir. Dal cercevesi bu sinirli beden durusu anlamini dogru temsil eder; sir, yuksek yer, cikinti veya kurtulus alanlariyla karistirilmaz.
semantic_detail.lexicalization_note: Bare kapsam, gerinme adini dalin yalın anlami olarak verir; belirli bir tamlamaya baglamaz.
semantic_detail.neighbor_coverage_note: Beden uzatma, boyun germe, yere serilme, oturus ve ayni kok dallari denetlendi; dar gerinme sinirini gosteren adaylar yayinlandi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bedensel gerinme olarak dar ve somuttur. Komsu dal genel uzatma alanidir ve bedene sinirli degildir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal ozellikle bedenin gerinme hareketidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal nesne, beden, el veya bakis gibi pek cok seyde genel uzatma ve uzanma alanini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da uzatma veya germe hareketi bulunur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dal bedenin belli parcasina, ozellikle boyna odaklanir. Bu dal daha genel gerinme hareketidir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal butun bedenin gerinmesini anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal ozellikle boynun uzunlugu, kaldirilmasi ve uzatilmasidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da bedensel uzama veya germe gorulur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal aktif gerinmeyi anlatir. Komsu dal yerde yayilma veya serilme durusudur; hareket ve beden iliskisi ayni degildir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal gerilerek uzama hareketidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal yere serilme, yayilma veya kollarin yere acilmasi gibi duruslari anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dal beden durusu ve uzanma sahnesinde temas eder.

semantic_detail.source_summary: Kaynak verisi bu dali gerinme hareketi olarak tekil ve dar bir anlamla verir.

support_registry.text: 2. **The reassurance addresses future and retained pain separately.** Lexical evidence: `تَخَف`, root `خ و ف`, `B001` (fearful anticipation of harm); `تَحْزَنْ`, root `ح ز ن`, `B001` (rough sadness in the self); `مُنَجُّوك`, root `ن ج و`, `B001` (deliverance by separation); and `ٱلْغَابِرِين`, root `غ ب ر`, `B001` (remaining residue). Structural cue: fear and sadness are coordinated but distinct, followed by rescue and the wife's exception. Assigned role: promised separation answers anticipated danger, while the named residue explains a ground for sadness that rescue does not erase. Abductive move: the text does not assign each emotion an object; I infer the future/past-relational division from branch scope and sequence. Reading change: reassurance is differentiated: safety is promised without pretending that relational loss is unreal.
29:56's declaration that God's earth is spacious is the clearest later correction to constricted reach. When local action-space closes, divinely supplied movement and rescue can reopen it.

- **Later correction (`29:56`):** “My earth is spacious” directly reverses the constricted reach of `ضَاقَ ... ذَرْعًا`. Lot's limited capacity was real but not total reality; later divine spaciousness shows that rescue can open actionable room beyond the distressed agent's measured reach.

1. **Moral distress rendered as lost room to act.** ض ي ق B001 is narrowness against spaciousness and B002 is chest constriction and distress. The narrowed ذرع gives distress a bodily measure before the messengers remove fear and grief by announcing rescue. I infer that Lot perceives no available reach within which to protect his guests; constriction reads as collapsed action-space, and reassurance reopens that space by supplying an external rescue mechanism.
